why: Without the % escape a literal %0A in a site label reaches GitHub raw, and GitHub decodes it to a line break.
With % after the line breaks, the %0D and %0A this function just wrote are escaped again to %250D and %250A.
A newline in a label splits the ::warning:: or ::error:: line and the rest of the label is lost.
Warnings printed without the escape reach the annotation raw (a literal %0A in a label becomes a line break), while reasons stay escaped.
